CAMEL-16030.title: camel-pulsar - Add async send to producer
CAMEL-16030.description:
The producer is synchronous today.

But pulsar allows to send async, where a CompletableFuture is returned. We can leverage this for async send, and call asyncCallvback from the future.

commits.message: CAMEL-16030: camel-pulsar - Add async send to producer
commits.author: essobedo

CAMEL-18981.title: camel-vertx-websocket: Add capability to capture peer connect / disconnect events
CAMEL-18981.description:
WebSockets with camel-undertow has a nice feature where you can set the option {{fireWebSocketChannelEvents}}, and you will get an exchange produced whenever a peer connects or disconnects on the WS server. Useful if you want to do some custom handling for these scenarios.

It'd be nice if vertx-websocket had a similar feature.

commits.message: CAMEL-18981: Add capability to vertx-websocket server for capturing peer connect / disconnect events
commits.author: jamesnetherton
